programme.title: Road absurdities 4
programme.desc: In the next series, Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysztof Ruszała continue their developing trips around Poland, during which they look for the causes of various absurd road solutions.Using a prototype siren with the mysterious symbol S201, they will go to places where officials lightly spent huge amounts of money on non-functional communication infrastructure facilities.A bicycle path with pedestrian crossings every few meters, a speed limit for only one lane, a "zebra" right behind the "parking" sign, poles at the entrances to the garage, a street lamp in the middle of the road - this is just the beginning of the list of topics that tireless hunters of road stupidity will face.
